title: Neural Corridor Post-Processing Lab
description: A BrainStem creature inhabits a space ship hallway, and the user operates a multi-layer post-processing pipeline to achieve a target visual signature. Six effect channels (bloom, chromatic aberration, vignette, film grain, color grading via LUT shift, and pixelation) must be balanced under an energy budget constraint. Users adjust sliders, couple effects, and use undo/redo to reach the goal state.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with EffectComposer from three/addons. Load BrainStem.glb and place it walking in a loop at the center of space_ship_hallway.glb. Camera is positioned inside the hallway looking down the corridor at the creature. Add ambient light 0x334455 intensity 0.6 and a point light 0xaaddff intensity 2 near the creature. Animate BrainStem using its first AnimationClip. Build a post-processing pipeline with six configurable passes: (1) UnrealBloomPass with threshold, strength, radius, (2) ShaderPass for chromatic aberration offset, (3) ShaderPass for vignette darkness and offset, (4) ShaderPass for film grain intensity and speed, (5) ShaderPass for color grading hue-shift in degrees, (6) ShaderPass for pixelation block size. Display a left-side panel with six sliders, each 0-100. Implement an energy budget of 300 total points across all six sliders combined. If the user raises one slider past the budget, automatically reduce the most recently changed other slider to compensate, enforcing conservation. Show the remaining budget as a bar. Generate a random target state of six values summing to 250 and display it as a small reference thumbnail rendered once with those settings. The user must match all six values within tolerance of 5 each. Implement full undo/redo with Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y tracking every slider change as a state snapshot, storing up to 30 states. Show undo/redo buttons in the panel. Add a coupling toggle button: when active, bloom and vignette sliders move inversely linked, and grain and pixelation move together. Display a match percentage indicator comparing current values to target. When all six channels match within tolerance, flash a green border and show success text. Ensure the render loop updates all shader uniforms each frame from slider values. Use dat.gui-free custom HTML sliders styled with dark sci-fi theme colors 0x0a0a1a background and 0x00ffcc accents.
